target: acceptances 1+2+5 — the build stage must delegate triage blind, place it before the second attempt, and require a root-cause regression test. Scoped to the triage STEP rather than a fixed line window, so the assertion does not depend on how long the step happens to be.
cmd: f="$PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/build/SKILL.md"; sec=$(awk "/^5b\\. \\*\\*Triage/{on=1} on{print} on&&/^6\\. \\*\\*/{exit}" "$f" | tr "\n" " " | tr -s " "); blind=$(printf "%s" "$sec" | grep -ci "not your reasoning\|NOT your reasoning\|blind protocol"); order=$(printf "%s" "$sec" | grep -ci "before the second attempt\|before any further change"); reg=$(printf "%s" "$sec" | grep -ci "regression test"); nobudget=$(printf "%s" "$sec" | grep -ci "no extra attempts\|does not increase the retry budget"); printf '{"len":%s,"blind":%s,"order":%s,"regression":%s,"noBudget":%s}' "${#sec}" "$blind" "$order" "$reg" "$nobudget"
